caseNameFull: Singletary, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections v. Smith

opinions.text:
C. A. 11th Cir. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Brecht v. Abrahamson, ante, p. 619.

Justice Blackmun, Justice Stevens, and Justice O’Connor dissent.
